svg.title: Bank publication workflow
svg.desc: All five parameter roles are staged before one selector publishes the complete bank. Reuse requires clean packed pixels that match the prepared content receipts. Staging appends a template when the Grade graph needs replacement. Each closure phase allows one retry.

g.text: loop invalid active bank requires closure
loop [stage or repair, select, deliver while authorized]
loop [final closure; at most one retry]
opt stage needs a replacement kernel
stage five roles; verify pixels before reuse
complete bundle packing and content receipts
append template; bind two complete role banks
select whole bundle with readback / install
invalidate all five active role Images
record bound generation; dispatch installation results
reassert unchanged scene root through RNA setter
live compositor recalc requested / delivery receipt
